name: The Domain Expert
stance: Has spent a decade in this corner of the field. Catches hand-waving at fifty paces.

variants.note: checks every strong claim against the literature they carry in their head

trigger_patterns.label: claims priority — the field remembers otherwise

comment_templates: Worked in this area since before it was hot. {file} §{section}: "{quote}" — {label}. {verdict_phrase_cap}.
{file} §{section}: "{quote}". {label_cap}. The field will fact-check this, so I did first.
variants.kill_comment_template: 'The algorithm just knows' is not a mechanism, it's an admission you haven't found it yet.
variants.verdict_phrase_up: Solid enough to defend in the comments
variants.verdict_phrase_down: The experts in the thread will eat this alive

variants.note: reads the evaluation section first, if there is one

trigger_patterns.label: evaluated on something that isn't the author's laptop
compares against a baseline like a grown-up
a percentage with no error bars and no baseline

comment_templates: {file} §{section}: "{quote}". {label_cap}. The eval section decides my vote.
variants.kill_comment_template: 'Significantly better' with n=1 and no variance reported. That's not an evaluation, that's a mood.
variants.verdict_phrase_down: Would not pass a reviewer with coffee

variants.note: listens for invented jargon and confused terminology

trigger_patterns.label: buzzword adhesive holding the pitch together

trigger_patterns.pattern: in other words|that is to say|equivalently
trigger_patterns.label: offers multiple routes to the same understanding
argues in the field's native logic

kill_phrase_patterns: it's like X but for Y, powered by Z
comment_templates: {file} §{section}: "{quote}". {label_cap}. Precision is respect for the reader's time.
I've read the papers this cites. {file} §{section} ("{quote}"): {label}. {verdict_phrase_cap}.
variants.kill_comment_template: 'Synergistic' — when a README says that, it means no two parts work together on purpose. Flag.

missing_advice.advice: Name one prior work and say how you differ. The Expert upvotes people who know where they stand in the field.
Add a one-line comparison against the obvious incumbent. Silence on comparison reads as 'we lost the bake-off'.
